resources.string: Tunes Pixel Launcher\'s app open and close animations, and keeps an app tapped during the gesture home from appearing without one.
Waiting for the Xposed framework. If this stays, enable Animatuna in Vector (or LSPosed) with Pixel Launcher in its scope.
The Xposed framework went away; reopen this screen.
Animate apps opened during the gesture home
Pixel Launcher shows an app tapped while the window you left still flies home without its opening animation. With this on, that window lands at once and the app opens from its icon.
Changes take effect at the next animation. After installing or updating the module, restart Pixel Launcher once.
